labs.research_summary:
Experimental development of novel semiconductor nanostructures for quantum information sciences.
Tailoring crystal symmetry and strain at the nanoscale to produce next generation optoelectronic devices.

AREAS OF RESEARCH EXPERTISE
• MBE growth, chamber maintenance, and system support.
• Low-temperature, high-field magnetoresistance quantized carrier/spin transport (quantum Hall 
effects, Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations, 1D quantized conductance, 0.7 structure, etc.).
• Atomic force microscopy (AFM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD) 
and photoluminescence (PL), Raman spectroscopy, ellipsometry, Rutherford back scattering, etc.
• Cleanroom-based micro/nanofabrication including photo- and e-beam-lithography, metallization, 
and device packaging
labs.notes: Breadth pass from Tufts School of Engineering's shared faculty directory (confirmed unfiltered by department query param; fetched once across all 8 pages and bucketed by each person's own department tag).

notes: IMPORTANT: targets.csv gives each engineering department a different field_department_tid query param, but it does NOT filter -- confirmed by comparing two tid values byte-for-byte identical. The directory covers all engineering departments plus secondary appointments, part-time lecturers and affiliates from several other Tufts schools. This file's labs were bucketed from ONE full crawl (8 pages, 374 people) by each person's own 'department-title' tag shown on their card. Titles of Professor/Associate/Assistant Professor and Research [Assistant/Associate] Professor were treated as PI-led labs; Part-time/Teaching/Adjunct/Affiliate/Visiting/Emeritus titles went to non_lab_people.
